subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Pump Curves: Matching Pump to System
description: A 60-second lesson on Pump Curves: Matching Pump to System.

hook.text: A pump can push hard or push a lot, but not both at once.

buildup.text: The pump curve plots flow rate against head pressure for a given speed.

discovery.text: The system curve shows how much resistance the piping creates at each flow.

twist.text: Where the two curves cross is the operating point. Miss it and you waste energy.

climax.text: Variable-speed drives shift the pump curve to match demand and save power.

punchline.text: The right pump is where two curves agree.

quiz.question: What determines a pump's operating point?
options: The intersection of the pump curve and the system resistance curve
The maximum pressure listed on the pump nameplate
The voltage supplied to the pump motor
